College of Computer Studies

SE 101: Software Engineering

1st Semester · SY 2026-2027 · Section: (Section) · Instructor: capybara

1. Course Learning Outcomes (CLOs)

CLO #Bloom's LevelDescriptionMapped PLOs
CLO 1 Remember/Understand Explain the phases of the software development life cycle and common process models. PLO 1
CLO 2 Apply/Analyze Analyze and document software requirements using structured specification techniques. PLO 2
CLO 3 Apply/Analyze Model software systems using UML diagrams for design and architecture representation. PLO 2, PLO 3
CLO 4 Apply/Analyze Apply software testing and quality assurance techniques to validate software correctness. PLO 2, PLO 3
CLO 5 Evaluate/Create Design and manage a collaborative software project applying Agile development practices. PLO 3, PLO 5
